g.text: Candidate plates, exact beveled ribs and spacer stack
C2.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY DESIGN — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
HOLE COORDINATES · FROM BLANK LOWER LEFT
4 × Ø0.5625 through each plate; break edges.
Four spacer annuli OD1 / ID0.5625, per foot.
Cap footprint retained; sole now matches cap footprint.
Full depth to bolt line Y±2.
Tail bevel to Y±3; mirror Y.
UPPER RIB · HP06F FRONT / HP06R REAR
Root at leg face; outer Y±2.875.
5/8 cap, 1/2 sole and 3/8 ribs address preliminary local screens; weld/rail-wall stress and fatigue acceptance is not established.
Exact blank DXFs are supplied for cap, sole, lower rib, front upper rib, rear upper rib and both pan blanks. CAD thickness remains separate.
Proposed control: shared plate datum; hole centres ±1/64; profile ±1/32. Machined spacer length ±0.05 mm, matched set spread ≤0.05 mm.
Final tolerance/finish controls require supplier and fabrication review. Do not cut production parts from this preliminary package.
C21-P01 · Canonical: build_c21.py / parameters.json / parts.json / drawing-edges.json · Dimensions govern; do not scale.
